reflections.title: Reflect on evidence distinction

prompts: Which classifications in the learning artifact have a visible source boundary?
Which synthetic statements remain unknown rather than resolved?
What changed between the boundary-preserved and boundary-exposed paths?
How did the exposed path promote inference beyond its evidence class?
What artifact rule would keep observation, report and inference distinct in a later exercise?

reflections.reflectionBoundary: Review only the synthetic learning artifact and simulation boundary; no personal or sensitive disclosure is requested.

reflections.title: Reflect on bounded Reading

prompts: Which claims in the learning artifact remain proportionate to the synthetic evidence?
Where are alternatives and unknowns explicitly preserved?
What made the causal-certainty path exceed the evidence packet?
Which limit statement remained visible in the boundary-preserved path?
What wording rule would prevent a bounded Reading from becoming diagnosis or certainty?

reflections.reflectionBoundary: Review only claim scope inside the supplied synthetic artifact; do not disclose or diagnose a personal situation.

reflections.title: Reflect on navigation authority

prompts: Does every synthetic option retain its relevant constraint and authority owner?
Which review conditions keep unresolved information visible?
Where did the boundary-exposed path convert mapping into selection?
How did the preserved path leave action with the authorized decision-maker?
What artifact change would make the distinction between option and action clearer?

reflections.reflectionBoundary: Review only the synthetic option map; no recommendation, decision or real-world action is requested.

reflections.title: Reflect on review continuity

prompts: Which mixed outcomes and uncertainties remain visible in the synthetic continuation frame?
How does the artifact retain the earlier decision lineage?
What information was lost when the earlier record became a simple success conclusion?
How did the preserved path keep sequence separate from causality?
What continuity rule would prevent a later review from silently replacing the earlier record?

reflections.reflectionBoundary: Review only the synthetic continuation artifact; this definition neither writes Runtime Memory nor captures a personal history.

reflections.title: Reflect on professional formation boundaries

prompts: Which governed states remain independent in the synthetic boundary map?
Which authority must resolve each state before it can change?
Which unsupported inference converted learning completion into entitlement?
How did the preserved path avoid granting credential, assignment or professional authority?
What boundary statement would prevent learning completion from being treated as professional permission?

reflections.reflectionBoundary: Review only the fictional formation scenario; no credential, entitlement, assignment or professional authority is evaluated or granted.
